title: The right-localized pullback of a category fibred in groupoids is fibred in groupoids

standard_prerequisites.name: Pullback of a fibred category
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides that u_pS is a fibred category and the fraction description of its morphisms.

standard_prerequisites.name: Fibred in groupoids
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the groupoid condition to invertibility of morphisms over identity arrows, and gives that all morphisms of S are strongly cartesian.

core_obligations: Reduce to invertibility: it suffices to invert every morphism of u_pS lying over an identity arrow.
Write such a morphism as a fraction ((a, b, alpha), r) with r in R; the base condition forces b = id_V.
Every morphism of S is strongly cartesian (fibred in groupoids), so the numerator lies in R and is invertible in u_pS.
proof_roadmap: Invertibility reduction plus the fraction description; the numerator lands in R and is inverted by the localization.
difficulty_reason: Three-step reduction, each step a direct reading of an already-proved description; no new construction.
